newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish jets in Iraq air raids on Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkish jets in Iraq air raids on Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Turkish air force planes have bombed suspected Kurdish rebel positions in northern Iraq, security officials said on Tuesday.

They said two F-16 jets based at Diyarbakir in southeastern Turkey bombed an area near Nazdur bridge, just across the border, in a bid to hit Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels on Monday. It was unclear if any guerrillas died in the air raid.
Turkish land and air forces often cross the mountainous border after the PKK, which uses bases in northern Iraq in its fight for self-rule in southeast Turkey.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict.
Security officials said gendarmerie forces had killed two rebels on Monday in a clash in the Turkish province of Batman.
